name: Iterapic
author: iterapic

sections.description:
Iterapic AI brings professional AI tools directly into your WooCommerce workflow. This plugin enables store owners to enhance their product visuals, upscale low-resolution photos, and generate engaging product videos without leaving WordPress.

By connecting directly to the Iterapic API, you can transform static images into dynamic assets that improve conversion rates and store aesthetics.

Major Features

  • AI Tools Modal: A clean, intuitive interface to select between Edit, Upscale, or Video actions.
  • Smart Prompting: Simply describe what you want for your photo editing and video creation.
  • WooCommerce Native: Generated assets are automatically added to your media library, respecting your store’s organization.
  • Seamless Workflow: Access tools from the product list (Quick Actions) or directly within the editor sidebar.
  • Enterprise-grade Security: Your API credentials are encrypted and stored using WordPress best practices.
  • Real-time Credits: Native display for Image and Video credits to manage your usage seamlessly.

PS: You will need an API Key from iterapic.com to use this plugin.

External services

This plugin connects to the Iterapic API (https://iterapic.com/) to provide AI-powered image editing, upscaling, and video generation services.

  • Service provided by: Iterapic (https://iterapic.com/).
  • Data sent: The plugin sends product image URLs, media files, and text prompts to the Iterapic API via an API Key provided by the user. No personal WordPress user data or sensitive store credentials are sent beyond what is strictly necessary for image processing.
  • User Profile for API Key and Buying Image/Video Credits: https://iterapic.com/dashboard
  • Terms of Service: https://iterapic.com/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://iterapic.com/privacy-policy
  • Refund Policy: https://iterapic.com/refund-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install the Iterapic Plugin from the plugin store page or upload the iterapic folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Iterapic and enter your API Key.
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API Key?

You can generate your token in your profile at https://iterapic.com/user/profile

Does it work with any product?

Yes, it works with any standard WooCommerce product that has a featured image.

Can I edit an image while creating a new product?

Yes, you can edit your image directly on the product editor, but you must save the featured image before using the AI tool.

How do I control video duration or movement?

Everything is controlled through the prompt. You can specify movements like “zoom in” or “orbit” directly in the text instructions, but videos have been optimized to last 5 seconds.

I can’t find the Iterapic panel or button on the product editor. Where is it?

You will find the Iterapic panel in the sidebar on the right side of the editor or the bottom area after the “publish” panel.

What happens if I run out of credits?

The plugin will display a “Limit Reached” message with a direct link to the Iterapic Dashboard where you can upgrade your plan or buy more credits.

How do I save my generated images/videos?

All content is automatically saved to your Media Library once it has been generated. Please make sure you don’t close modal during content processing.

0.2

  • Added real-time credit tracking for Image and Video tokens.
  • Improved modal performance for instant loading (no more lag when switching modes).
  • Standardized all interfaces to English.
  • Added support for video generation and automated media library saving for images and videos.
  • Improved API client reliability and security.
  • Added preview buttons for images and video and another button for changing Featured Image for generated image

0.1

  • Initial beta version with basic image upscaling and editing.
